description: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has captured remarkably detailed infrared images of PMR 1, known as the “Exposed Cranium,” a planetary nebula roughly 5,000 light-years away in the constellation Vela. The observations reveal a glowing inner “brain” region surrounded by a hydrogen gas shell, divided by a dark lane of ejected material, providing fresh insight into the brief, dramatic final phase of a dying star’s evolution.
title: James Webb Telescope Captures Stunning Infrared View of Exposed Cranium Nebula

description: Apple is believed launch its long-awaited iPhone Fold later this year. While Apple remains tight-lipped about the development of a foldable iPhone, a new rumour claims the upcoming foldable will have a barely noticeable crease in its internal screen, offering an immersive experience.T he foldable iPhone is expected to be launched alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models.
title: Apple Said to Lower iPhone Fold's Crease to Under 0.15mm; First Foldable Still Expected to Debut in 2026

description: Meta has announced that Instagram will notify parents if supervised teens repeatedly search for suicide or self-harm related terms within a short period. The feature will roll out next week in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, and Canada, with other regions to follow. Alerts will be sent via email, text, WhatsApp, or in-app notifications and include expert resources. Meta said it analysed search behaviour to set alert thresholds and plans similar parental notifications for certain teen interactions with its AI tools later this year.
title: Instagram to Warn Parents When Teens Search for Self-Harm Content

description: Nothing Headphone (a) will be launched on March 5. The company has also scheduled to launch the Phone 4a series on the same date. Nothing shared a poster suggesting the design of the upcoming audio device. It is expected to have a transparent design. The Headphone (a) is likely to come as an affordable version of the Nothing Headphone 1. It could cost GBP 149 (roughly Rs. 18,700) in the UK.
title: Nothing Headphone (a) Confirmed to Launch Alongside the Upcoming Nothing Phone 4a Series

description: The Poco X8 Pro series has cleared UAE’s TDRA certification, indicating a global launch may be near. Model numbers 2511FPC34G and 2602BPC18G confirm the Poco X8 Pro and X8 Pro Max names. The phones are expected to be rebranded Redmi Turbo 5 models from China. Leaks suggest 1.5K OLED displays, MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Ultra and 9500s chipsets, 50-megapixel primary cameras, and large 6,500mAh and 8,500mAh batteries with 100W charging support.
title: Poco X8 Pro, Poco X8 Pro Max Appear on TDRA Database Hinting at Imminent Global Debut

description: Apple Pay will be launched by the Cupertino-based tech giant in the middle of this year, according to a report citing people in the know of the matter. The company is reportedly in talks with multiple financial institutions at the moment for the launch of its digital payments solution in the country, including ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, and Axis Bank. Recently, reports of Apple holding conversations with various payment networks, like Visa and Mastercard, surfaced online, hinting that the service could be introduced in the country by the end of 2026.
title: Apple Pay India Launch: Apple Said to Be in Talks With Major Banks, Could Launch By Mid-2026

description: Asus has refreshed the TUF Gaming A14 laptop in India, switching to AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 392 processor with integrated Radeon 8060S graphics for the latest model. Asus says the new APU is much more power efficient and can rival graphics performance of dedicated GPUs. In our early tests, that seems to be the case. Here are our first impressions of the TUF Gaming A14 laptop.
title: Asus TUF Gaming A14 (2026) First Impressions

description: The Oppo Find N6 will have a Hasselblad-tuned 200-megapixel quad camera setup. This information was confirmed by Zhou Yibao, an Oppo executive, in a post on Chinese social media Weibo. The upcoming phone will be the only folding smartphone to include Oppo's proprietary Danxia colour lenses. The post also confirms the crease improvements and the existence of a Find N6 Satellite Edition.
title: Oppo Find N6 Rear Camera Features, Hasselblad Tuning Teased by Oppo Executive; Quad-Camera Setup Confirmed

description: The OTT platforms are set to drop top movies and series that include Accused, Ikkis, The Bluff, Andha Pyaar 2.0, and more.

title: Sangamarmar Now Streaming on JioHotstar: Everything You Need to Know

description: The Oakley Meta Vanguard and Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 are now available for purchase in India via the leading e-commerce platforms. The smart glasses have been developed by Meta, in collaboration with the sports equipment manufacturer Oakley and EssilorLuxottica, respectively. While the Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 is the successor to the Ray-Ban Meta Glasses, the Oakley Meta Vanguard is aimed at athletes engaging in outdoor activities.
title: Oakley Meta Vanguard and Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2 Now Available for Purchase in India via Amazon, Flipkart

description: Realme Narzo Power 5G will launch in India on 5 March at 12pm IST with a 10,001mAh battery as its key highlight. It features a 6.78-inch 144Hz display, MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset, and a 50-megapixel Sony IMX882 camera with OIS. The phone supports 27W charging, reverse charging, and 90fps BGMI gameplay. It runs Android 16-based Realme UI 7.0 and will receive three years of OS updates and four years of security patches.
title: Realme Narzo Power 5G India Launch Date Announced, Will Be Second Phone With 10,001mAh Battery

description: Asus ROG Flow Z13-KJP (GZ302EAC), ProArt GoPro Edition (PX13), and 2026 TUF Gaming A14 laptops were launched in India. They come with Windows 11 Home and run on AMD Ryzen Max AI processors. The ROG Flow Z13-KJP has a 13.4-inch display. The ProArt GoPro Edition (PX13) has a 13.3-inch 3K screen, while the new TUF Gaming A14 features a 14-inch 2.5K panel.
title: Asus ROG Flow Z13-KJP, ProArt GoPro Edition and TUF Gaming A14 (2026) Launched in India; Price, Features

description: iQOO Z11x 5G will be launched in India soon, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Thursday. A dedicated microsite for the unveiling of the handset is now live in the country on the iQOO India website, revealing the upcoming phone’s design, price range, and key specifications. The iQOO Z11x 5G is teased to be powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset, along with at least 8GB of RAM and at least 256GB of onboard storage. It is teased to be equipped with a dual rear camera unit, housed inside a square-shaped rear camera unit.
title: iQOO Z11x 5G India Launch, Price Teased; Key Specifications Including Dimensity 7000 Series Chip Revealed

description: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion will be launched in India on March 6, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. The handset is already confirmed to go on sale in the country via Flipkart. It will be offered in Pantone Silhouette, Pantone Blue Surf, and Pantone Country Air colour options. All three colourways are teased to boast a “leather-inspired” texture on the rear panel. The handset will pack a 7,000mAh silicon carbon battery, with support for 68W wired fast charging. It will be powered by a Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion India Launch Date Announced; Will Arrive After MWC 2026

description: Perplexity AI on Wednesday announced Perplexity Computer, a new multi-model AI workflow system. It is designed to help users perform complex research and task execution through a coordinated network of AI models. The system is claimed to be built to go beyond single-model chat interfaces by enabling multiple AI systems to collaborate on research, reasoning, and structured outputs within a unified environment.
title: Perplexity Computer Unveiled as Unified, Multi-Model AI Workflow Platform: Key Features, Availability

description: Vivo V70 Elite and Vivo V70 are now available for purchase in India, the company announced on Thursday. Both phones are on sale in the country via Flipkart, Amazon, Vivo India online store, and other offline retail channels. The Vivo V70 Elite is sold in India in Authentic Black, Passion Red, and Sand Beige colourways, while the standard model is offered in Lemon Yellow and Passion Red colour options. Both phones pack 6,500mAh batteries. The two are equipped with triple rear camera units, housed inside square-shaped rear camera modules.
title: Vivo V70 Elite, Vivo V70 With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Cameras Go on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: The Vivo X300 Ultra has cleared Indonesia’s SDPPI certification, confirming its name and model number V2562, while the X300 FE appeared as V2537. Earlier IMEI, EEC, and TKDN listings revealed only model numbers. The X300 Ultra is expected to launch globally soon. Leaks suggest it may debut with an attachable 400mm teleconverter lens. Rumoured specifications include a 6.82-inch 2K LTPO OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, 7,000mAh battery, and dual 200-megapixel rear cameras.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Moniker Revealed as Handset Bags Indonesia's SDPPI Certification Alongside Vivo X300 FE

description: Apple opened doors to its second retail store in Mumbai and the sixth overall store in India on Thursday. The new store, named Apple Borivali, is located in a key residential and commercial hub in the western suburbs of Mumbai. It becomes the company’s second store in the city after Apple BKC, and adds to its growing retail footprint in India. Like the preceding outlets, Apple Borivali offers a full range of services for Apple devices, including purchases of products and accessories.
title: Apple Borivali Now Open for Customers as Mumbai’s Second Apple Store After BKC

description: Apple has been rumoured to be working on a low-cost MacBook for quite some time now. Although no official announcement has been made so far, a recent leak suggests that the Cupertino-based tech giant could make some compromises in terms of hardware to offset costs. It is tipped to miss out on a True Tone display, high peak brightness, and a backlit keyboard. The low-cost MacBook may also omit fast charging support.
title: Apple’s Rumoured Low-Cost MacBook Tipped to Miss Out on True Tone Display, Fast Charging Support

description: Motorola Razr Fold was showcased during the CES 2026 last month. Now, the company confirmed that the Razr Fold will get "every detail" revealed on March 2 during the MWC 2026. The book-style foldable smartphone will be launched in two colourways with an 8.1-inch internal display and a 6.6-inch cover screen. It has a triple rear camera setup including three 50-megapixel sensors.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Set to Take on Honor Magic V6 at MWC 2026; More Details to Be Revealed on March 2

description: Google showcased the new Gemini 3 series-powered AI features that will be available on select models in the Samsung Galaxy S26 series during Samsung’s Galaxy Unpacked February 2026 event. The Mountain View-based tech conglomerate has announced that soon the Galaxy S26 series, Pixel 10, and Pixel 10 Pro in the US and South Korea will receive the new Task Automation feature, which will initially be available in preview. This will allow users to delegate simple day-to-day tasks to the AI tool. Moreover, Google is bringing on-device scam detection to the Samsung Phone app for the Galaxy S26 lineup and the enhanced Circle to Search feature.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Gets Powerful New Gemini AI Features Alongside Google Pixel Phones

description: Motorola has announced the Android 17 Beta programme for select devices across the world. The list of eligible smartphones includes the Moto G57 Power in India and Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), the Moto G57 in EMEA, and the Moto Edge 2025 in the US. Users can enrol for the Android Beta programme by filling out a form. The tech firm announced the new Android 17 beta programme in the US via a community post. This makes Motorola the second company to start the beta programme for the latest Android version after Google started rolling out the update to select Pixel devices.
title: Motorola Announces Android 17 Beta Programme for Select Devices in India, US and Other Regions

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra was launched in India and global markets during the company's latest Galaxy Unpacked event. The new flagship phone will rival the iPhone 17 Pro Max. Both feature 6.9-inch displays and offer similar connectivity and battery features. The Galaxy S26 Ultra has a quad rear camera unit, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max has a triple rear camera setup. Here's a comparison to help you decide which flagship is the best for your needs.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra vs iPhone 17 Pro Max: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 starts at Rs. 87,999 and features a 6.3-inch 120Hz AMOLED display, Exynos 2600 chip, triple cameras with 3x optical zoom, and a 4,300mAh battery. The iPhone 17, priced from Rs. 82,900, offers a 6.3-inch 120Hz ProMotion OLED display, A19 chip, dual 48-megapixel cameras, and improved battery life claims. While Samsung provides a dedicated telephoto lens and larger battery, Apple focuses on efficiency, brightness, and computational photography enhancements.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 vs iPhone 17: Price in India, Specifications and Features Compared

description: As smartphones increasingly rely on AI-driven personalisation, more sensitive information is visible on-screen. For this, Samsung’s newly launched Galaxy S26 Ultra brings a potentially game-changing feature. It has introduced a new display technology that aims to enhance on-device privacy. Called Privacy Display, the feature is built directly into the handset’s screen and is designed to limit side-angle visibility without affecting the user’s viewing experience.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display Explained: How Flex Magic Pixel Works

description: Planning to purchase the newly launched Samsung Galaxy S26 series, but wondering where it is going to be the cheapest? As the global availability is set to begin soon, the price variations in different markets may have a significant effect on your purchase. With the pre-orders now live, let’s take a closer look at how the Galaxy S26 series is priced in India before moving on to where it may be the cheapest.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Price: US vs Europe vs India — Where Is It Cheapest to Buy?

Scheduled to go on sale globally soon, the three new handsets are currently available for pre-order. However, if you were wondering how much the phones cost across the world, and what the RAM and storage variants are available in different regions, we have curated a price list for you.
